ios.desc:
Meet the next generation of your favorite calculator. The official HP 12c Platinum app, now brings a completely redesigned interface, a modern look, and improved functionality—while preserving the precision and reliability trusted by professionals for decades.

Built for everyday use in business, banking, real estate, and education, the new HP 12c Platinum brings a timeless classic into the modern era.

The HP 12c Platinum You Know – Now Better Than Ever
• Official emulator of legendary calculator device by Hewlett-Packard
• Identical algorithms, layout, and keystrokes as the original HP 12c Platinum
• RPN (Reverse Polish Notation) for fast and efficient input
• Built-in financial tools: loan payments, TVM, NPV, IRR, cash flows, bonds, and more

Be Ready. Anywhere. Anytime.
Whether you’re in class, at the office, or on the go, HP 12c Platinum is ready when you are. Just launch the app on your iPhone and get to work.

Download HP 12c Platinum today and experience the perfect blend of classic functionality and modern design.
